summary: Read buffer, byteOffset, byteLength, and length with resizable/out-of-bounds semantics.

semantics.out_of_bounds: length/byteLength/byteOffset become 0 for out-of-bounds typed arrays under current ECMAScript semantics

tests.name: fixed metadata
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(8); const a=new Uint16Array(b,2,2); console.log(a.buffer===b,a.byteOffset,a.byteLength,a.length);

tests.name: length tracking resize
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(4,{maxByteLength:8}); const a=new Uint8Array(b); b.resize(6); console.log(a.length,a.byteLength);
